## Verdict: FAIL — one blocker (B-1); seven minor notes (N-1 to N-7) are in `M0-f-02a-notes.md`

**B-1 — the batched timing mode's §12.1 protocol defaults are held by no test.** The item's `builds` promises
batches "run as ≤ 60 s batches after 30 s idle". C-0097, which the item cites, adds "the detector (C-0103) samples
every 30 s throughout every run". The runner gets both by forwarding `opts.idleMs` and `opts.sampleEveryMs`
(`runner.ts` l. 261–262) to M0-f-01's `timeBatch`, whose defaults are `IDLE_MS` and `SAMPLE_EVERY_MS` (30 000 ms each).
Every batched test passes `idleMs: 0` (`fixture.ts` `readings()`), and none asserts the batched sampler's period.

Two targeted mutants survive the whole near set (`bench/test/tiers/`, 60 tests). **R19** changes
`idleMs: opts.idleMs` to `idleMs: opts.idleMs ?? 0`: no idle before any batch. **R20** changes
`sampleEveryMs: opts.sampleEveryMs` to `sampleEveryMs: opts.sampleEveryMs ?? 1_000`. The test titled "the idle wait
precedes every batch (30 s by default; the fixture passes 0)" checks only the 60 s cap.

The code as landed is right. The checker's probe P3 (below) ran three real jobs batched with no `idleMs` and took
155 s for 5 attempts, which is 30 s of idle per attempt (CONFIRMED). But a regression would pass silently. M0-t-00's
gating `tier:pr` figure would then be taken with no idle on the fanless reference host and still be stamped by the
detector. That is a silently wrong committed result and a broken contract with M0-t-00 (its brief: "after 30 s idle",
"the detector's 30 s samples in every record").

Required change: add a test in `bench/test/tiers/modes.test.ts` that fails when a batched run whose caller passes
neither `idleMs` nor `sampleEveryMs` waits less than 30 s before each batch attempt, or samples at a period other than
30 s. Two ways to do it:
- fake timers, or a stub on the sleep, show that ≥ 30 000 ms passes before each attempt, and the stub sampler logs
  `start 30000` once per batch;
- a spy on `timeBatch` shows that both options reach it unset, or set to `IDLE_MS` and `SAMPLE_EVERY_MS`.

R19 and R20 must be killed. Reword the misleading test title.
